evidence.detail: Exact v308 loads fragmentsenc.txt, badenc.txt, domainenc.txt and tldlist.txt from the word-encoding archive into the class's fragment/bad-word/domain/TLD tables.
The class normalizes/filter-scans char arrays with bad-word pair tables, domain/TLD rules, fragment lookup and leetspeak-equivalent matching, then restores allowed/case behavior.
Client initializes the class during startup from rs/x/f and invokes rs/d/c.b(String) on multiple decoded/displayed chat-message paths before publishing text to chat/player state.
Historical Jagex/317 client source exposes the same four wordenc resources and matching multi-stage filtering under class name Censor, including the familiar exception-word family.

candidates.note: Source-proven historical class identity; pinned exact-v308 bytecode remains runtime authority.
